<<0+2>> note: resumed "Orchestrate cockpit fleet work" (CawCo orchestrator; /home/bewinxed/cockpit; hub obelisk-of-light; Mac). Owner rules: robust fix, honest caveat unfixed=not done, no fallbacks/unit tests/shims; UI advisor→preview→pick→build. Live: nightly 3238, TestFlight 20261015.3. Pending: owner picks, Mac scroll gate, Caw dirty files, retire worktrees. work: b7c9d8c2 scroll gate landed 48109ebbc (waits for Mac load <20); nightly 3238 published, 27/27 PASS; 3238 installed on both machines; Unii restarting in place.

<<8+2>> echo: delegates: 7c34546f waiting (tabs preview :5199), c3201594, a4e27882, b2a591a2 running; six done ones clean, on main. Unii rm -rf'd their folders: agent refilled stand-ins. Hub archive worked for 24bdfe4f only; other five gave 409 (husk, "no git clone"). origin/main grep located guard in workspace.ts/stand-ins.ts/harness.ts.

<<10+2>> echo: .out untracked file; origin/main is 48109ebbc. Checked six spent workspaces (24bdfe4f, 3eaedef2, e4cddd10, b6132a26, aff64726, b7c9d8c2): all ahead=0 dirty=0. Unii: removing them.

<<12+2>> echo: after rm -rf, leftovers (opencode.jsonc, .vscode, .opencode) remained, not immutable. Located retire logic (hub stream/work-items/server, agent stand-ins). Hub POST /api/workspaces/<id>/archive archived 24bdfe4f (HTTP 200, folder gone).

<<16+2>> Hub archive of other five (3eaedef2, e4cddd10, b6132a26, aff64726, b7c9d8c2) returned 409; reason: folder holds entries and is no git clone, nothing deleted; suggested discard:true (saves to ~/.cawco/carries). Retry with discard gave 502. Disk 97% (54G free).

<<22+2>> Unii delegated "Let husk workspaces archive cleanly" (instance fcdafab0, workspace dfbe4033; fixes placeSkill, straysIn, discard). Saved memory_note: retire via hub archive POST, never rm folder. Queried 74 active obelisk workspaces; 12 candidates in /tmp/ws-mine.txt; ran clean check.

<<44+2>> Archived five clean workspaces via hub: f037cc8c, c04ef394, cf58f5c7 HTTP 200 (folders gone); 4e129ba9 409 (husk, 2 entries, 53 KB); d1907cd7 502 ("boundary ... is not alive"). /home free 61G (97% used).
